title: Wiemer waitlist (v2)
description: A grey sign-up band: centred accent tag, a very large heading whose letters rise in, a short paragraph, then a form card (grey price box in mono, email field, consent, full-width accent button) centred over a field of big pale perforation dots that darken under the pointer.
notes: the dots show from lg up; phones get the heading and the card
posts to `action`; wire validation and sending in your app
